api_only_exclusions: range invalidity requires nonfinite/out-of-bound transform, unavailable through native ranges and bounded steppers.
round>=3 cannot submit through live controls: completion clears/destroys them and callback guards round/dead.
Both range and anchors rejection map to the same fixed hint; even an API-only range path would not add a different text.
guard.persistent_secondary: Every slider onInput calls draw; archive-feedback has three literal branches. Ready is not a rejection but included to satisfy the complete secondary owner domain.
guard.excluded_unrelated_owner: archive-round has three fixed stage instructions, not refusal feedback; original reports retained. Shared pause/blurb strings are outside module error-longest.

api_only_exclusions: NaN/out-of-bounds/noninteger selection cannot be generated by three fixed choices, native range and bounded stepper.
dt is clamped0..0.1 by runner and again before observe; negative/>0.2 observe guard cannot be reached.
No API-only validation text is rendered.
guard.persistent_secondary: Choice and duplicate handlers never set peace-status. Once a voice is heard, duplicate can preserve recorded, clipped, or listening status. Listing only duplicate hint is insufficient.
guard.excluded_unrelated_owner: peace-voice changes only after successful recording, to one of three fictional voices; it is not a refusal/status handler. Shared pause/blurb strings retain original report flags and are not module error-longest candidates.
